groups.problem: BackupCode.tsx declares its component as TwoFactor instead of BackupCode.
groups.rationale: Both flag the same component declaration and request the same rename.

groups.problem: Backup-code verification uses non-constant-time Array.indexOf comparisons.
groups.rationale: The same comparison pattern appears independently in login authorization and the disable endpoint. Each location requires the same change in comparison approach.

groups.problem: Non-atomic backup-code consumption allows concurrent logins to reuse a single-use code.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same read-check-update race in authorize and propose atomic consumption or concurrency control.
